app.name: MediCare+
app.tagline: Your medicines, check-ups and reports in one place

landing.heroTitle: Never miss a dose. Never lose a report.
landing.heroText: MediCare+ reminds you to take your medicines, keeps doctor visits on track, and stores your prescriptions and test results safely in one place.
landing.benefitsTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don't
landing.b1Text: Set the times once. See what is due today and mark each dose as taken or skipped.
landing.b2Text: Save appointments and get a reminder a day or an hour before.
landing.b3Text: Keep prescriptions and lab reports private and easy to find by date.
landing.b4Text: Put test results from different dates side by side on a simple chart.
landing.privacy: Your records are private. Only you can see them.
landing.s1Text: Type the name and the times from your prescription.
landing.s2Text: See what is due today and tap Taken or Skip.
landing.s3Text: Store reports, track visits and compare test results over time.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to keep your health in one place?
landing.ctaText: Create a free account in under a minute.

disclaimer: MediCare+ is a student health-management project. It does not diagnose conditions or prescribe medicines. Always follow your doctor's advice.

tips.adherence: Counts doses from the last 7 days that were taken, skipped or missed. Doses that are not due yet are not counted.
tips.statuses: Due now means it is time to take it. Overdue means that time passed a while ago. A dose that is not due yet is never counted as missed.
tips.notifications: Browser notifications work while MediCare+ is open. You can turn them on or off at any time.
